snippet.title: Roombattle - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🤖💥 ROOMBATTLE IS OUT NOW ON STEAM! 💥🤖

Your vacuum cleaner is now a weapon. Roombattle is the chaotic party battler where you and up to 6 friends control fully customizable robotic vacuum cleaners — armed with sharp objects and loaded with balloons. Pop everyone else's balloons. Be the last one standing. Destroy your friendships in the process.

⚔️ WHAT IS ROOMBATTLE?
Roombattle is a fast-paced Vacuum Party Battler playable solo or with up to 6 players in online AND local multiplayer. Battle across unique, interactive arenas packed with traps, dangers, and environmental chaos — smash a fish tank, crash through office supplies, or wreck a 240-million-year-old dinosaur skeleton. All in the name of fun.

🎈 GAME MODES & MINIGAMES
Beyond the balloon-popping battles, Roombattle features a huge variety of wild minigames — dance-offs, soccer, pool parties, and even actual room cleaning. No two matches feel the same.

🎨 CUSTOMIZE YOUR VACUUM
With nearly 200,000 customization combinations, dress your vacuum as a pirate, a unicorn, a Viking with a magic wand — anything goes. The more you play, the more you unlock through a full progression system.

🕹️ PLAY YOUR WAY
Only 2 buttons + a stick needed. Compatible with controllers, keyboards, and even your smartphone as a controller. Accessible to everyone, chaotic for all.

🔗 GET ROOMBATTLE ON STEAM (OUT NOW!)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223000/Roombattle/
